summary.en: French AI company with efficient open-source models and strong multilingual support.
summary.zh: 法国 AI 公司，提供高效的开源模型和强大的多语言支持。

title.en: Mistral AI API Key - Open Source French AI Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: Mistral AI API Key - 法国开源 AI 模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Mistral AI API key for efficient open-source models. Access Mistral Large, Mixtral and Codestral.
description.zh: 获取 Mistral AI API Key，访问高效的开源模型。使用 Mistral Large、Mixtral 和 Codestral。

en: Mistral AI is a French AI lab known for efficient open-weight and commercial models with strong multilingual performance, including Mistral Large, Codestral, and vision models like Pixtral.
Developers use the Mistral API for chat, coding, and multimodal workloads through an OpenAI-compatible style interface documented at docs.mistral.ai.
zh: Mistral AI 是法国 AI 实验室，以高效开源权重与商用模型见长，多语言表现突出，产品线包括 Mistral Large、Codestral 以及 Pixtral 等视觉模型。
开发者可通过 Mistral API 做对话、编程与多模态任务，接口风格接近 OpenAI，文档见 docs.mistral.ai。

en: Open https://console.mistral.ai/api-keys and sign in or create a Mistral account.
Create a new API key in the console and copy it once; store it securely.
Call the official Mistral API base URL with your key as described in the docs.
Rotate or revoke the key in the same console if it is leaked or unused.
zh: 打开 https://console.mistral.ai/api-keys ，登录或注册 Mistral 账号。
在控制台创建新的 API Key，复制后妥善保存（通常只展示一次）。
按官方文档使用该 Key 调用 Mistral API 地址。
若 Key 泄露或不再使用，请在同一控制台轮换或吊销。

question.en: Where do I create a Mistral API key?
question.zh: 在哪里创建 Mistral API Key？

answer.en: Only on the official console at console.mistral.ai/api-keys. getModelKey does not issue keys.
answer.zh: 请到官方控制台 console.mistral.ai/api-keys 创建。getModelKey 不发放 Key。

question.zh: Mistral 模型都是开源的吗？

answer.en: Mistral offers both open-weight releases and hosted API models. Check the official site for the license of each model.
answer.zh: Mistral 同时提供开源权重与托管 API 模型，具体许可以官网对各模型的说明为准。
